name: status-housekeeping-anomaly-disagreement
title: Leftover local branches block every housekeeping run as a strict anomaly
description: Leftover local branches are a strict anomaly, so housekeeping — which invokes the status collector with --expect-clean — returns blocked with status_anomalies on every run in a repository that keeps branches around, while ordinary sd-status reports them as expected clean state. A verdict that is blocked on every clean merge carries no information.
creator: sdelmas
